findings.note: Leaf symlinks are deliberately accepted, but PRE-image capture and recovery read them through Path.read_bytes(). A publication target symlink can therefore point outside the repository—including at credential material—and its referent bytes are read and copied into .resolver-staging/pre, violating the explicit security boundary that the Resolver never reads a credential. The leaf-symlink fixture covers only an in-tree referent and does not exercise this case.
